newsitem.title: FRANCE: Ex-mayor's American ex-wife held in France.
newsitem.headline: Ex-mayor's American ex-wife held in France.

text.p: French police detained the American ex-wife of former Nice mayor Jacques Medecin on Sunday when she flew into the Riviera capital of Nice for a holiday.
Police sources said an investigating magistrate wanted to question Ilene Joy Graham about tax arrears alleged to be owed by Medecin.
Medecin, mayor of Nice for a quarter of a century until 1990, lives in exile in Uruguay after serving a two-year prison sentence in France for corruption.
